capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same pack as the 2025 refresh (no 2026 pack or charging change found; 2025 and 2026 compared). 89 kWh gross (InsideEVs table; Porsche pages give no 89 kWh figure). Pack from trim: named in the trim.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same pack as the 2025 refresh (no 2026 pack or charging change found; 2025 and 2026 compared). 82.3 kWh usable (InsideEVs table; Wikipedia 82.3 / 97 net).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the 2025-on 105 kWh pack as NMC 811 (third-party; Porsche does not name the chemistry for the Taycan). The 89 kWh pack assumed the same family.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Porsche: "system voltage of 800 volts instead of the usual 400 volts".

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: combines two Porsche pages, each covering half: the range-planner page ("the system also regulates the preconditioning of the battery in good time before the charging stop") and the Porsche US Charging Planner page (planner preconditions the battery; needs route guidance, no manual trigger; Taycan 2020 to present). Charging Planner regulates battery preconditioning before the charging stop while navigating (Porsche newsroom); Porsche US support page applies it to Taycan 2020 to present. No manual battery-preconditioning button found (a departure timer preconditions battery and cabin for the plug-in case).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same pack as the 2025 refresh (no 2026 pack or charging change found; 2025 and 2026 compared). Up to 270 kW (InsideEVs: base battery 270 kW; Porsche quotes 320 kW only for the Plus pack).

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: same pack as the 2025 refresh (no 2026 pack or charging change found; 2025 and 2026 compared). InsideEVs gives 18 min 10-80% for both packs (the Porsche US page does not name the pack).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same pack as the 2025 refresh (no 2026 pack or charging change found; 2025 and 2026 compared). InsideEVs 2025 table: on-board charger 9.6 kW (US). Porsche's global release says 11 kW standard (Europe); 19.2 kW optional in North America. Canada assumed equal to the US.
